# InNetworkNeuromorphicComms

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The integration of neuromorphic processing directly within communication nodes to enable intelligent, low-power signal classification and adaptive routing. Reduces data movement and latency in distributed networks, a core requirement for scalable iNEST deployments in sensor and EW systems.
